body.zh-Hant: 據阿根廷政府網頁，伊里戈延1852年7月12日生於布宜諾斯艾利斯。他1872至1877年任巴爾瓦內拉區警長，1878至1880年為省議員，1880至1882年為國會眾議員。另據該頁，他1880至1905年擔任阿根廷歷史教師。
body.en: According to the Argentine government page, Yrigoyen was born in Buenos Aires on 12 July 1852. He was Comisario of Balvanera in 1872–1877, provincial deputy in 1878–1880 and national deputy in 1880–1882. The same page says that in 1880–1905 he worked as a teacher of Argentine history.

citations.quote: El 12 de julio de 1852 nació en Buenos Aires
Fue Comisario de Balvanera (1872-1877)
Diputado Provincial (1878-1880)
Diputado Nacional (1880-1882)
Entre 1880 y 1905, se desempeñó como profesor de Historia Argentina

heading.en: Leader of the Radical Civic Union

body.zh-Hant: 阿根廷政府網頁稱他1890年加入公民聯盟，並創立激進公民聯盟，並主持布宜諾斯艾利斯省委員會；1904年他重建激進主義，次年發動新的革命。《拉丁美洲歷史與文化百科》稱到1898年他已是公認的激進派領袖，該黨在1912年前採取不參選的棄權策略。
body.en: The government page says he joined the Unión Cívica in 1890, founded the Unión Cívica Radical and presided over the Buenos Aires provincial committee; in 1904 he refounded radicalism and the next year led a new revolution. The Encyclopedia of Latin American History and Culture says that by 1898 he was the acknowledged leader of radicalism and that the party abstained from polls until 1912.

citations.quote: En 1890 integró la Unión Cívica
fundó la Unión Cívica Radical (UCR)
presidiendo el Comité de la provincia de Buenos Aires
en 1904 refundó el radicalismo y al año siguiente condujo una nueva revolución
By 1898 Irigoyen was the acknowledged leader of radicalism
pursuing a strategy of abstention from polls until 1912

body.zh-Hant: 據《拉丁美洲歷史與文化百科》，他1916年贏得總統職位，第一任期為1916至1922年；他曾干預各省選舉以確保激進黨勝利。阿根廷政府網頁稱他1918年把存在倫敦的黃金運回國，1922年創立國營石油公司YPF，但任內發生悲慘週、森林公司事件與巴塔哥尼亞叛亂等工人遭鎮壓事件。
body.en: The Encyclopedia says he won the presidency in 1916 and that his first term ran 1916–1922; he intervened in provincial elections to secure Radical victories. The government page says that in 1918 he repatriated the Argentine gold deposited in London and in 1922 founded the state oil company YPF, but that his term was marred by the Semana Trágica, La Forestal and the Patagonia Rebelde, in which many workers were killed.

citations.quote: In 1916 Irigoyen won the presidency of Argentina
Irigoyen's first term (1916–1922)
intervened in provincial elections to assure Radical victories
en 1918 repatrió el oro argentino depositado en Londres
En 1922 fundó Yacimientos Petrolíferos Fiscales (YPF)
la Semana Trágica, la Forestal y la Patagonia Rebelde
su mandato se vio manchado por tres tristes acontecimientos
con gran cantidad de obreros muertos a manos de las fuerzas de seguridad

body.zh-Hant: 據《拉丁美洲歷史與文化百科》，他1928年贏得第二個任期。阿根廷政府網頁稱他無法任滿，1930年9月6日被烏里布魯將軍領導的政變推翻，之後被囚禁在馬丁·加西亞島，1932年2月20日結束囚禁，並於1933年7月3日在布宜諾斯艾利斯去世。
body.en: The Encyclopedia says he won a second term in 1928. The government page says he could not complete it: he was deposed on 6 September 1930 in the coup led by General José Félix Uriburu, was confined on Martín García island, saw his captivity end on 20 February 1932, and died in Buenos Aires on 3 July 1933.

citations.quote: After Irigoyen won a second term as president in 1928
No pudo terminar su segundo mandado
fue derrocado el 6 de septiembre de 1930
liderado por el general José Félix Uriburu
confinado a la isla Martín García
El 20 de febrero de 1932 finalizó la dictadura y también el cautiverio
Falleció en Buenos Aires el 3 de julio de 1933

body.zh-Hant: 據《丹麥傳記辭典》，斯陶寧在哥本哈根的無產階級環境中長大，後來當學徒成為雪茄分揀工，1891至1893年在腓特烈西亞的雪茄廠工作。Lex 條目稱他1890年加入社會民主黨，1896至1908年任雪茄分揀工工會主席。他1906年10月在議會初次發言。
body.en: According to the Dansk Biografisk Leksikon, Stauning grew up in Copenhagen's proletarian milieu, trained as a cigar sorter, and worked at a cigar factory in Fredericia from 1891 to 1893. Lex says he joined the Social Democrats in 1890 and chaired the cigar sorters' trade union in 1896–1908. He made his first speech in the Folketing in October 1906.

citations.quote: Stauning voksede op i det københavnske proletariat
Han kom derefter i lære som cigarsorterer
Efter læretiden rejste han 1891 til Fredericia
hvor han arbejdede på J. P. Schmidts cigarfabrik indtil 1893
Stauning meldte sig ind i Socialdemokratiet i 1890
var 1896-1908 formand for Cigarsorterernes Fagforening
Staunings debut i folketinget skete i oktober 1906

body.zh-Hant: Lex 條目稱1910年他當選為克納森的繼任者，出任黨主席兼議會黨團主席。《丹麥傳記辭典》也說他1910年成為黨魁。1916年他以控制部長身分加入札勒政府，1916年9月30日獲接納；此後他續任到1920年，負責勞動市場事務。
body.en: Lex says that in 1910 he was elected successor to P. Knudsen as party chairman and chairman of the parliamentary group; the Dansk Biografisk Leksikon likewise says he became party leader in 1910. He entered the Zahle government as a control minister in 1916, being admitted on 30 September 1916, and continued until 1920 with responsibility for labour-market affairs.

citations.quote: han i 1910 trods en del modstand kunne vælges
til P. Knudsens efterfølger som partiformand og formand for rigsdagsgruppen
Han blev partileder 1910
indtrådte Stauning i 1916 i regeringen Zahle som kontrolminister
den 30.9.1916 optaget som kontrolminister
fortsatte han indtil 1920 med ansvar for arbejdsmarkedssagerne

body.zh-Hant: 據《丹麥傳記辭典》，斯陶寧1924年出任政府首腦，並兼任商業部。Lex 條目載明他自1924年4月24日起任首相，至1926年12月14日。該政府提出裁軍等主張而未能實現，之後政府宣布於1926年12月2日舉行選舉，選後他辭職。
body.en: According to the Dansk Biografisk Leksikon, Stauning took over as head of government in 1924 and also took the commerce ministry. Lex gives his premiership as running from 24 April 1924 to 14 December 1926. The government's causes, disarmament and works councils, were not carried through; the government called an election for 2 December 1926 and resigned afterwards.

citations.quote: en dansk parlamentarisk statsminister der 1924 overtog posten som regeringschef
der selv tillige overtog handelsministeriet
fra 24. april 1924 til 14. december 1926 og igen fra 30. april 1929
To mærkesager blev ført frem, afrustning og bedriftsråd, men gennemførtes ikke
udskrev den valg til 2.12.1926
og Stauning trådte tilbage

heading.zh-Hant: 長期執政與「丹麥為人民」
heading.en: Long premiership and Danmark for Folket

body.zh-Hant: 據《丹麥傳記辭典》，1929年4月30日組成的內閣由三名激進派與九名社民黨人組成，斯陶寧自己接掌新設的航運與漁業部。Lex 條目稱這是二十世紀任期最長的政府，並於1933年1月與自由黨達成坎茨勒街協議；1935年黨以「斯陶寧或混亂」為口號得票46.1%。1939年他因健康欠佳，黨主席由赫德托夫接任。
body.en: The Dansk Biografisk Leksikon says the ministry appointed on 30 April 1929 had three Radicals and nine Social Democrats, and Stauning himself took a new ministry for shipping and fisheries. Lex calls it the longest-sitting government of the 1900s; the Kanslergade settlement with Venstre followed in January 1933, and in 1935 the party won 46.1% under the slogan Stauning or Chaos. In 1939 he was replaced as party chairman by Hans Hedtoft owing to failing health.

citations.quote: ministeriet udnævnt 30.4.1929 med tre radikale og ni socialdemokrater
Selv overtog Stauning et nyt ministerium for søfart og fiskeri
Det blev 1900-tallets længst siddende regering
indgået mellem regeringen og Venstre i januar 1933
opnåede 46,1 % af stemmerne
valget i 1935, da partiet under sloganet "Stauning eller Kaos"
forkastet ved en folkeafstemning i 1939, og samme år afløstes han
som partiformand af Hans Hedtoft
afløstes han pga. svigtende helbred som partiformand af Hans Hedtoft

body.zh-Hant: Lex 條目稱，政治穩定一直持續到1940年4月的占領。德國占領對斯陶寧打擊很大，但他仍續任首相，主張採取合作政策。他的首相任期至1942年5月3日。
body.en: Lex says political stability lasted until the occupation in April 1940. The German occupation hit Stauning hard, but he continued as prime minister and argued for a policy of cooperation. His premiership ran until 3 May 1942.

citations.quote: helt frem til besættelsen i april 1940
Den tyske besættelse ramte Stauning hårdt
men han fortsatte som statsminister
og igen fra 30. april 1929 til 3. maj 1942
og argumenterede for en samarbejdspolitik
var medlem af Folketinget i perioden 1906-1942

body.zh-Hant: 據《拉丁美洲歷史與文化百科》，迪亞斯生於哥斯大黎加，原是美國公司在布盧菲爾茲的礦業公司秘書，1909年保守派推翻自由派獨裁者塞拉亞時進入尼加拉瓜政壇。塞拉亞下台後，埃斯特拉達成為總統，迪亞斯為副總統；1911年5月8日埃斯特拉達在戰爭部長梅納領導的叛亂下辭職，迪亞斯繼任總統。
body.en: According to the Encyclopedia of Latin American History and Culture, the Costa Rican-born Díaz had been a secretary of a mining company, a U.S. firm based in Bluefields, and entered Nicaraguan politics during the Conservative overthrow of the Liberal dictator José Santos Zelaya in 1909. After Zelaya's ouster Estrada became president and Díaz his vice president; on 8 May 1911 Estrada resigned in the face of a revolt led by Minister of War Luis Mena, and Díaz succeeded to the presidency.

citations.quote: the Costa Rican-born Díaz entered Nicaraguan politics
Previously a secretary for La Luz and Los Angeles Mining Company
a U.S. firm based in Bluefields
Conservative overthrow of Liberal dictator José Santos Zelaya in 1909
Estrada became president and Díaz, his vice president
a revolt led by Minister of War Luis Mena
On 8 May 1911, Estrada resigned in the face of a revolt
Díaz succeeded to the presidency

heading.zh-Hant: 與美國的關係和1912年叛亂
heading.en: Ties with the United States and the 1912 revolt

body.zh-Hant: 同一條目稱，他上任一個月後簽署一項條約，允許尼加拉瓜政府向美國私人銀行貸款。他與美國走近使他失去國內支持，梅納指他出賣國家；1912年7月梅納發動叛亂，保守黨領袖查莫羅擊敗梅納，但迪亞斯控制不了局勢，塔夫脫總統於8月4日派出海軍陸戰隊。
body.en: The same entry says that a month into his presidency he signed a treaty with the U.S. permitting the Nicaraguan government to negotiate a loan with U.S. private banks. His closer ties with the United States cost him support at home, and Mena declared that he had sold out; in July 1912 Mena led a revolt, which Conservative leader Emiliano Chamorro defeated, but Díaz failed to control the situation and President Taft dispatched the marines on 4 August 1912.

body.zh-Hant: 美國國務院歷史學家辦公室頁面稱，重組後的國會於1926年11月11日選迪亞斯為候任總統，他11月14日宣誓，美國代辦11月17日承認其政府。《拉丁美洲歷史與文化百科》稱前自由派副總統薩卡薩宣稱自己為總統，並在蒙卡達支持下起兵，迪亞斯在美國協助下結束內戰，掌控政府到1928年，期間與美國合作發展國民警衛隊。
body.en: The Office of the Historian says a reconstituted Congress elected Díaz President Designate on 11 November 1926, that he took the oath on 14 November, and that on 17 November the U.S. Chargé d'Affaires extended recognition to his government. The Encyclopedia says the former Liberal vice president Juan Bautista Sacasa claimed the presidency and rose against him with José María Moncada's support; with U.S. help Díaz ended the civil war and held the government until 1928, cooperating with the United States in developing the National Guard.
